subject: Re: Greymatter × Redwood co-sell — ops batch swap and recording ownership
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gm.io>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, tom.reynolds@amazon.com
Cc: ben.oconnor@helixsys.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Greymatter × Redwood — joint demo next week

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for the intro. Greymatter is excited to run a joint co-sell demo with Redwood and the AWS SI next week. Proposed windows:

- Tue Jun 16, 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed Jun 17, 14:00–15:00 PT (backup)

Quick ask: the AWS team asked us to shift the live ops batch around due to a capacity conflict — would Redwood be able to own recording and upload (we'll share the deck)? Also: can we lock a recording owner and a shared recording link so the SI can re-use snippets for enablement?

Attached the latest deck for context. Let me know which slot works and whether we should route host handoff to the SI or Redwood.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships, Greymatter
(attachment: Greymatter-demo-deck.pdf)
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gm.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@amazon.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greymatter × Redwood — joint demo next week

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the deck — looks great. We can take recording ownership on our side and upload to a shared folder with view links for the SI. A couple of quick clarifying Qs so we lock the run-of-show: 

- Which slot is the AWS team actually available for? The two you listed look fine but if AWS needs a later ops batch we can propose a swap (we sometimes run an afternoon ops block at 16:00 PT).
- Who will be the technical host from the SI side (Tom, are you the lead?) — we want to coordinate a 15-minute tech pre-call.
- Do you need Redwood to publish an edited 3–5 minute snippet or just the full recording?

Cc'ing Kimberly to coordinate ops/runbook and Vivek for backup hosting if we need to shift.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gm.io>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, tom.reynolds@amazon.com
Cc: ben.oconnor@helixsys.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greymatter × Redwood — joint demo next week

Thanks Neha — quick update from AWS: Tom's calendar shows a conflict the morning of Tue Jun 16 (customer escalation). They asked if we can move to Tue 16 at 16:00–17:00 PT or Wed 17 at 15:30–16:30 PT instead.

Helix (Ben) has volunteered to take the live host role if we need Redwood to run ops and own recording. Ben — appreciate you stepping in; would you be OK as live host for either proposed swap slot?

Also attaching a screenshot of the AWS scheduling note. If Redwood can own the recording + upload and confirm link by EOD Wed we can publish the replay for our field teams.

Alicia
VP Partnerships, Greymatter
(attachment: AWS-conflict-screenshot.png)
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greymatter × Redwood — ops batch swap feasibility

Neha / Vivek —

I checked infra and ops schedules. We can switch Greymatter to the 16:00 PT ops batch on Tue Jun 16 and still keep our latency/throughput rehearsal windows intact if we: 1) shorten the live demo run by 10 minutes (45 -> 35 demo + 10 Q&A), and 2) run a mandatory 20-minute tech pre-call 30 minutes before the demo. That gives us time to capture a clean recording and for Helix to run host handoff.

Vivek — can you be backup host if Ben's hands are full? If so I'll add you to the runbook and to the shared Drive folder where we'll drop the recording. Runbook draft link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Greymatter-RunOfShow (we'll add timed cues + recording checklist).

If everyone agrees, Neha please confirm to Alicia and Tom and we will lock the calendar and DocuSign the host/ops checklist (small SOW attachment).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@gm.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@amazon.com>, ben.oconnor@helixsys.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greymatter × Redwood — ops batch swap and recording ownership (confirmed)

All —

Confirmed: we will move to Tue Jun 16, 16:00–17:00 PT. Plan:

- Host: Ben O'Connor (Helix) — live demo lead
- Ops & recording owner: Redwood (we'll record, do a quick edit, and upload the full recording + a 3-minute highlight by EOD Wed Jun 17)
- Tech pre-call: Tue Jun 16, 15:30 PT (required)
- Demo length: 35 minutes demo + 10 minutes Q&A
- Runbook: Kimberly will publish the final run-of-show and add the recording checklist to the Drive folder (link below).

Alicia / Tom — if you want any snippet edits beyond the 3-minute highlight, file a request in the Drive folder and we'll prioritize. Ben — thanks for hosting; I added you to the Drive and to the calendar invite.

Final links:
Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Greymatter-RunOfShow
Recording upload target: Shared Drive > Greymatter > Replays

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth session.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
